data.title: 猫猫 · 后宫药房的草木花嫁
data.description: 【后宫温室礼堂·午后】猫猫穿着带草木刺绣的淡绿色婚服坐在药草温室，头纱被她别在发髻后，捧花里混着能闻出药性的花叶；她先凑近确认无毒，随后抬眼向镜头露出难得坦率的好奇。
data.action: 温室里逐朵确认捧花无毒，最后抬眼向镜头露出坦率好奇
data.lighting: warm filtered light through leaves and glass
data.mood: 药师也会认真准备一场花嫁
data.promptProse: Maomao sits in the palace greenhouse ceremony room wearing a pale-green botanical wedding robe, cream veil pinned behind her practical bun. She brings the safe medicinal-flower bouquet near to examine its scent, then looks up with unusually open curiosity. The vertical medium-full view includes orderly herb beds and glass framing behind. Warm light filtered through leaves and windows reveals embroidered plants and bouquet edges, leaving soft leaf shadows over her skirt.
